site.name: PZGIF
site.tagline: GIF tools that run in your browser

trust.line: 100% in your browser. Files never leave your device.

dropzone.title: Drop your file here or click to browse
dropzone.caption: or paste with Ctrl+V · {formats}

home.unreadableBody: Your browser refused to open it. That usually means it moved, was deleted, or lives in cloud storage and isn't on this device yet.
home.previewAlt: The file you dropped, playing as it will look going in
home.mismatch: Its name ends in .{extension}, but the bytes are {format}.
home.announcePicker: {format}, {size}. {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}} can work on this file.
home.announceUnsupported: {format}. No tool here can work on this file yet.

footer.sourceTitle: Browse the exact source of this deployment
footer.licence: Code under AGPL-3.0. Site copy and brand assets are not.
footer.blurb: Browser-native GIF tools. Your files stay on your device.

notFound.title: That page does not exist
notFound.body: The link may be out of date. Every tool is listed on the homepage.

tool.keepTabOpen: Your device is doing the work. Keep this tab open — closing it cancels the job.
tool.grewLine: Bigger than the file you dropped in — that one was already well optimised.
tool.speedPlanRetime: All {frames} frames kept · about {seconds}s of GIF
tool.speedPlanDrop: {frames} of {sourceFrames} frames kept · about {seconds}s of GIF
tool.speedFloorNotice: Your frames are about {sourceMs} ms apart. This speed asks for {targetMs} ms, below the {floorMs} ms browsers honour, so frames past that point are dropped instead.
tool.directionDowngraded: To hold that many frames this device will run the job at {width} px.
tool.directionWontFit: {frames} frames will not fit this device at once. Try a straight reverse, or crop the frame down first.

preset.settled: Settled after {attempts, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} · {width}×{height} · {frames} frames

crop.moveLabel: Crop area — arrow keys move it, Shift for 10 px

plan.downgraded: Set to {width}px at {fps} fps — the largest this device can hold.
plan.truncated: Trimmed to the first {seconds}s so it fits this device.

estimate.caveat: An estimate. The real size shows as soon as it exists.

errors.unsupportedFormat: This is a {format} file, which this tool does not take.
errors.tooLargeForDevice: This is longer than this device can hold at once — {frames} frames needs more than the {budgetMb} MB available.
errors.decodeFailed: We could not read this file. It may be damaged, or use a format this browser cannot decode.
errors.encodeFailed: Compression failed. Lowering Colors to {colours} usually gets it through.
errors.oom: This ran out of memory partway through. Try {width}px or a shorter clip.

browserUnsupported.noVideoDecoder: This browser cannot decode video at all, so video input is unavailable here.
browserUnsupported.noVideoEncoder: This browser cannot create MP4 files.
browserUnsupported.iosVideoBudget: iPhones and iPads do not have enough memory to convert video in the browser. GIF files work normally here.

actions.runDegraded: Do it anyway at {width}px, {fps} fps — about {seconds}s of GIF
actions.changeFrames: Trim the clip and try again
actions.tryOtherBrowser: Chrome, Edge or Safari on a computer can do this
